description: This PHP source file generates test reports and dashboards for the TestLink open-source test management tool. It loads configuration, initializes report parameters, gathers metrics from the database, and optionally creates spreadsheets for detailed report analysis. The file references other internal scripts for configuration, display, and common utilities, and manages complex report generation workflows including platform-specific, milestone, and status reports.
